title: PRO for Fighting FT in Ovarian Cancer
official: Patient-Reported Outcome for Fighting Financial Toxicity in Ovarian Cancer
summary: Non-profit, multicenter, prospective, observational study. This study aims to evaluate whether the articulated treatment algorithm that is now possible for OC patients does produce tangible changes of financial distress over the time and whether the determinants of financial distress change their relative weight over the time.

sites.f: Nation Cancer Institute of Naples, Division of Medical Oncology - Uro-Gynecology Department
